name: Obira (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Obira town emblem in red and white: a red outlined hexagon edged white enclosing a five-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Obira, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 26 November 1937.

features.role: Obira town emblem — a red outlined hexagon edged white enclosing a five-pointed star
